task.description: WF-02 step 02e (ORCH): infrastructure action for the login-directory pepper

result.summary: INFRASTRUCTURE ACTION required on every host that runs a build containing PR #2201, BEFORE the merge to main triggers QA's redeploy (QA redeploys on every merge; config/runtime.exs refuses to boot in EVERY environment without these, so a host without them will not start). (1) Generate the pepper with `openssl rand -hex 32`: exactly 64 lowercase hex characters, NOT all zeros, NOT all f, and DIFFERENT from LETFLOW_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY. (2) Choose a key id matching [a-z0-9_-]{1,32} (for example p2026a); it is stored on every directory row and must NEVER be reused for a different pepper. (3) Put both in the host's deploy/.env (the env_file next to docker-compose.qa.yml, template deploy/.env.example): LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER=<64 hex> and LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER_ID=<id>. Never commit, log, paste into a ticket or hand off the value. (4) LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER_PREVIOUS and LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER_PREVIOUS_ID are for rotation only: set BOTH or NEITHER, previous must differ from current (value and id); leave blank in steady state. (5) The migration (public table tenant_login_directory with key_id) runs with the deploy. A developer database that already ran the earlier version of migration 20261004000001 needs `mix ecto.rollback --step 1` then `mix ecto.migrate`. (6) After the deploy run the backfill, dry run first, then for real, in a maintenance window (insert-only, no lock): without it existing users are undiscoverable. Mix form (dev/CI): `mix letflow.backfill_login_directory --dry-run` then `mix letflow.backfill_login_directory`. RELEASE FORM (a deployed release container has NO Mix; verified on QA by infra T-0154): `bin/letflow rpc 'Letflow.LoginDirectory.Backfill.run(dry_run: true) |> IO.inspect()'` then `bin/letflow rpc 'Letflow.LoginDirectory.Backfill.run() |> IO.inspect()'` (output is per-tenant counts and key ids, never an email; rpc sets no exit status, read the printed result). The same call is the re-keying step after a pepper rotation. (7) Do NOT enable LETFLOW_LOGIN_DISCOVERY_ENABLED outside dev: 0042 OQ-3 (lawful basis and controller) is unresolved and gates enabling. (8) EXTERNAL: ai-dala-infra's landscape/secrets-inventory.md needs an entry for LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER and LETFLOW_LOGIN_DIRECTORY_PEPPER_ID per environment (QA, production), owner and rotation procedure; that repository is not edited from here. Rotation tooling (retire_key, key_status, runbook) is REQ-443, not yet built.
